linked_prs.title: feat: Enhanced DingTalk toolkit integration - fixes #3050
linked_prs.body:
## Description

This PR provides a comprehensive DingTalk integration for CAMEL, enhancing the original work by @waleedalzarooni with 9 additional enterprise features. The implementation includes 18 DingTalk API functions covering messaging, user management, department operations, and group management.

**Key enhancements:**
- 9 new DingTalk API functions (total: 18 functions)
- Enterprise messaging capabilities (action cards, OA messages, batch notifications)
- Complete user and department management features
- Advanced group operations and management
- 28 comprehensive unit tests with 100% pass rate
- Full API compliance with official DingTalk specifications
- Production-ready error handling and input validation

Built upon the excellent foundation by @waleedalzarooni, this enhancement transforms the basic integration into a comprehensive enterprise solution.

Fixes #3050

## Checklist

Go over all the following points, and put an `x` in all the boxes that apply.

- [x] I have read the [CONTRIBUTION](https://github.com/camel-ai/camel/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md) guide (**required**)
- [x] I have linked this PR to an issue using the Development section on the right sidebar or by adding `Fixes #issue-number` in the PR description (**required**)
- [x] I have checked if any dependencies need to be added or updated in `pyproject.toml` and `uv lock`
- [x] I have updated the tests accordingly (*required for a bug fix or a new feature*)
- [x] I have updated the documentation if needed:
- [x] I have added examples if this is a new feature

**Additional Details:**
- ✅ **Dependencies**: No new dependencies required - uses existing `requests` library
- ✅ **Tests**: Added 11 new comprehensive unit tests (28 total, all passing)
- ✅ **Documentation**: Complete docstrings for all 18 functions with official API references
- ✅ **Examples**: Enhanced example file with practical usage demonstrations
- ✅ **Code Quality**: Full ruff and mypy compliance
- ✅ **Backward Compatibility**: All original functions work unchanged
